name: Authentic South Indian Brass Coffee Filter
description:
Bring back the ritual of slow, measured, unhurried filter coffee into your everyday. Made of solid brass, our Filter Set is designed the way it has been for generations. With simplicity. Use it to extract thick, strong, aromatic decoction from your coffee and pour it into a tumbler with intention. 
  Why Brass  
 Brass has always been part of traditional South Indian kitchens. It holds heat well, ages beautifully, and adds a certain weight to the process. It’s something you can feel in your hands every morning. 
  What’s Included  
 
 Upper chamber (for coffee powder) 
 Lower chamber (to collect decoction) 
 Press disc 
 Lid 
 
  Care Instructions  
 
 Wash gently with mild soap 
 Dry immediately to avoid water marks 
 Over time, brass may naturally darken 
 Polish occasionally if you prefer a brighter finish

name: Authentic South Indian Brass Davara Set
description:
A traditional companion to filter coffee that reflects the heritage of South India’s finest coffee culture. Perfect for coffee mixing and cooling, the davara set not only maintains the temperature but also enhances the flavor, making each sip an indulgent experience. 
 Whether you’re sipping on Estate Filter Coffee at home or gifting a coffee lover, this set adds a touch of timeless tradition. The warm golden hue of the brass ages beautifully over time, giving it a unique patina, reflecting authentic craftsmanship.  
  Features:  
 
 
 Material:  100% Brass (Food-safe) 
 
 Usage:  Ideal for serving South Indian Filter Coffee 
 
  Hunkal Estate Coffee Recommends  
 The davara set has been traditionally used by us to pour and aerate filter coffee, amplifying the flavors and aroma. Pair it with our South Indian Filter Coffee to enjoy an authentic experience at home.
